lines.text: Jehoshaphat was buried in the City of David, and Jehoram, his firstborn, reigned and killed all his brothers.
Jehoram became king at thirty-two, reigned eight years in Jerusalem, and married a daughter of Ahab.
Edom rebelled and appointed their own king, so Jehoram crossed into Edom and attacked by night; Hebron rebelled too.
A letter came to Jehoram from Elisha the prophet, warning of a serious blow and a disease of his bowels.
The Philistines and Arabs invaded Judah and left Jehoram only Jehoahaz; the LORD afflicted him, and he died in pain.
